id: 09_Donning and Doffing PPE in Clinical Laboratories Basic PPE for Routine Laborator
title: 临床实验室防护装备穿脱：常规操作的基本防护
source_doc: course/CDC Laboratory Safety Series/09_Donning and Doffing PPE in Clinical Laboratories Basic PPE for Routine Laborator.md
author_source: project/CDC Laboratory Safety Series/09_Donning and Doffing PPE in Clinical Laboratories Basic PPE for Routine Laborator/src.py

points.K2: 个人物品留在实验室外
points.K11: 重复使用的实验服挂指定处
points.K12: 污染的实验服卷起丢弃

shots.scene: 欣欣穿着白色实验服、戴着安全眼镜，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot wears a white lab coat and wraparound safety glasses and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲基本防护装备的穿与脱。
overlay: 临床实验室防护装备穿脱：常规操作的基本防护

shots.scene: 实验服、手套、安全眼镜三个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a white lab coat, a pair of blue gloves and wraparound safety glasses. No people.
shots.narration: 适用于常规的实验室操作。

shots.scene: 小研来到临床实验室门口，准备开始一天的检测
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student arrives at the door of a clinical laboratory, ready to start a day of routine testing.
shots.narration: 小研要做一批常规检测。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在她身边，竖起一根手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside her and raises one finger with a friendly smile.
shots.narration: 我们跟着她，一步步穿上、脱下。

shots.scene: 欣欣指向衣架上的实验服、手套和安全眼镜
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to a white lab coat on a hanger, a pair of blue gloves and wraparound safety glasses on a bench.
shots.narration: 常规操作，需要三件基本装备。

shots.scene: 安全眼镜特写，包绕式侧护高亮
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of wraparound safety glasses slowly rotating, with the side shields highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 实验服、手套，加上包绕侧护的安全眼镜。

shots.section_title: 个人物品留在实验室外
shots.scene: 戒指和智能手表特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a ring and a smart watch on a wrist. No people.
shots.narration: 穿戴前，先摘下首饰和手表。
overlay: 个人物品留在实验室外

shots.section_title: 个人物品留在实验室外
shots.scene: 小研把外套和包放进实验室外的柜子
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts her jacket and bag into a cabinet in the corridor outside the lab.
shots.narration: 外套、手机、笔和多余的包，

shots.section_title: 个人物品留在实验室外
shots.scene: 手机、笔、包的图标放进门外柜子
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a phone, a pen and a bag going into a cabinet outside a lab door. No people.
shots.narration: 都放在实验室以外的地方。

shots.scene: 小研侧面，用发圈把长发束起
shots.prompt_en: Side view of the female graduate student tying her long hair back into a ponytail with a hair tie.
shots.narration: 有长头发的，要把头发束起来。

shots.scene: 台面上依次摆出紧袖口实验服、安全眼镜和一盒手套
shots.prompt_en: A clean bench with a folded lab coat with knit cuffs, safety glasses and a box of gloves with a blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 备好紧袖口实验服、手套和侧护眼镜。

shots.scene: 小研对比两件不同大小的实验服，挑出合身的一件
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds up two lab coats of different sizes and picks the one that fits.
shots.narration: 实验服和手套，尺码要合适。

shots.scene: 放大镜检查实验服，领口扣子处画圈
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass over a lab coat, with a circle drawn around the snaps at the collar. No people.
shots.narration: 穿前目视检查，有没有撕裂、破洞。

shots.scene: 缺了一颗扣子的位置被圈出
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a lab coat placket with one missing snap circled. No people.
shots.narration: 扣子有没有缺，也要看一看。

shots.scene: 小研穿上实验服，把扣子一颗颗扣好
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts on the lab coat and fastens every snap from collar to hem.
shots.narration: 先穿实验服，扣子全部扣好。

shots.scene: 小研戴上安全眼镜，对镜头微笑
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, in a fastened lab coat, puts on wraparound safety glasses and smiles at the camera.
shots.narration: 然后，戴上安全眼镜。

shots.scene: 小研戴上蓝手套，手套口盖住实验服袖口
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pulls on blue gloves so the glove cuffs extend over the knit sleeve cuffs of her coat.
shots.narration: 最后，戴上手套。

shots.scene: 衣、镜、手套三个图标用箭头连成顺序
shots.prompt_en: Three icons linked by arrows in order: lab coat, safety glasses, gloves. No people.
shots.narration: 顺序是：实验服、眼镜、手套。

shots.scene: 灰色背景上出现一张空白卡片和几个箭头
shots.prompt_en: A grey background with a blank card and several different arrow paths. No people.
shots.narration: 脱卸防护装备，有好几种策略。

shots.scene: 从深红到浅绿的渐变条，手套在最红一端
shots.prompt_en: A color bar from dark red to light green; a glove icon at the red end, a coat icon in the middle, glasses near the green end. No people.
shots.narration: 本课演示：从最脏到最干净依次脱。

shots.scene: 小研双手戴手套，手套盖住袖口，慢慢抬起
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student slowly raises both blue-gloved hands, the gloves covering her coat cuffs.
shots.narration: 先摘手套，动作要慢、要轻。

shots.scene: 拇指和食指成L形，垂直捏起另一只手套腕部外侧
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a gloved thumb and index finger form an L shape, perpendicular to the wrist, and pinch the outside of the other glove at the wrist. No people.
shots.narration: 拇指食指成L形，捏起手套腕部外侧。

shots.scene: 捏起时离开袖口，袖口打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: the pinching fingers stay clear of the coat cuff; the clean cuff is marked with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 小心，脏手套别碰到实验服袖口。

shots.scene: 手套被整只拉下，翻成里朝外
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: the glove is pulled down and off completely, ending up inside out. No people.
shots.narration: 整只拉下，让它翻过来。

shots.scene: 刚脱出的裸手握住翻面的绿色示意手套
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: the newly bare hand holds the inside-out glove, which is highlighted in green to show it is turned. No people.
shots.narration: 用刚脱出的手，握住这只翻面手套。

shots.scene: 裸手捏住另一只手套的腕部
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: the bare hand, still holding the inside-out glove, pinches the wrist of the remaining glove. No people.
shots.narration: 再捏住另一只手套的腕部，

shots.scene: 手套向上、远离手腕拉起后脱下
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: the remaining glove is pulled up and away from the wrist and slides off. No people.
shots.narration: 向上、远离手腕拉起，把它脱下来。

shots.scene: 戴手套的那只手保持平展
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: the gloved hand stays flat and relaxed while its glove is being removed. No people.
shots.narration: 脱的时候，戴手套的手保持平展。

shots.scene: 两只干净的裸手展开，污染外表面没被碰到
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: two clean bare hands open, with the dirty outer glove surfaces never touched, a green check above. No people.
shots.narration: 干净的手，不碰手套的污染外面。

shots.scene: 小研把手套丢进红色脚踏式生物危害废物桶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student drops the gloves into a red pedal bin with a plastic liner and a biohazard warning sign.
shots.narration: 手套丢进生物危害废物容器。

shots.scene: 用过的手套放回盒子的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of used gloves being put back into a glove box, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 用过的手套，不能重复使用。

shots.scene: 实验服正面全身，外表面泛着淡淡的污染点
shots.prompt_en: A full front view of a lab coat; faint contamination dots on the front and sleeves. No people.
shots.narration: 裸手别碰实验服可能污染的外面。

shots.scene: 手套盖住袖口的示意，袖口打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a glove extending over a knit sleeve cuff, then the glove removed and the clean cuff marked with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 袖口工作时被手套盖着，应是干净的。

shots.scene: 小研用裸手解开实验服扣子
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, with bare hands, unfastens the snaps of her lab coat.
shots.narration: 解开实验服的扣子。

shots.scene: 一只手捏住另一只袖口，把手臂抽出
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: one bare hand pinches the opposite knit cuff and pulls that arm out of the sleeve. No people.
shots.narration: 捏住一只袖口，把手臂拉出来。

shots.scene: 换手捏住另一只袖口抽出手臂
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: the freed hand pinches the other cuff and pulls the second arm out. No people.
shots.narration: 另一只手臂，也同样操作。

shots.section_title: 重复使用的实验服挂指定处
shots.scene: 小研把实验服挂到指定挂杆的衣架上
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hangs the lab coat on a hanger on a designated coat rail.
shots.narration: 可重复使用的实验服，挂到指定区域。
overlay: 重复使用的实验服挂指定处

shots.section_title: 污染的实验服卷起丢弃
shots.scene: 实验服下摆有一块绿色污渍
shots.prompt_en: A lab coat with a green stain near the lower hem, with a yellow warning triangle beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 有可见污染，或者决定丢弃时，
overlay: 污染的实验服卷起丢弃

shots.section_title: 污染的实验服卷起丢弃
shots.scene: 里面朝向自己，蓝色箭头示意向外折
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: hands hold the lab coat with its inside facing the person; blue arrows show folding it away from the body. No people.
shots.narration: 让里面朝向自己，向外折起来。

shots.section_title: 污染的实验服卷起丢弃
shots.scene: 实验服被卷成里朝外的一团
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: the lab coat is rolled inside out into a tight bundle, the stain hidden inside. No people.
shots.narration: 再里朝外卷成一团。

shots.section_title: 污染的实验服卷起丢弃
shots.scene: 衣服团丢进红色生物危害废物桶
shots.prompt_en: The rolled lab coat bundle goes into the red lined pedal bin with a biohazard warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 丢进生物危害废物容器。

shots.scene: 小研侧面，手指捏住太阳穴处的镜腿摘下眼镜
shots.prompt_en: Side view: the female graduate student removes her safety glasses by grasping the frames at her temples.
shots.narration: 摘眼镜，捏住太阳穴处的镜腿。

shots.scene: 镜片标出污染点，镜腿打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of safety glasses: the lens front marked with contamination dots, the arms at the temples marked with green checks. No people.
shots.narration: 这里被污染的可能性比较小。

shots.scene: 眼镜放到台面指定位置
shots.prompt_en: The safety glasses are placed on a designated spot on the bench. No people.
shots.narration: 放到指定区域，下班后再消毒。

shots.scene: 一盒手套和一瓶空白标签的表面清洁剂
shots.prompt_en: A box of gloves with a blank label and a surface cleaner spray bottle with a blank label on a bench. No people.
shots.narration: 清洁眼镜时，要戴上手套。

shots.scene: 清洁剂瓶旁有对勾和沙漏图标
shots.prompt_en: The surface cleaner bottle with a green check, next to an hourglass icon. No people.
shots.narration: 用美国环保部门认可的清洁消毒产品，

shots.scene: 戴手套擦拭眼镜，沙漏在旁计时
shots.prompt_en: Gloved hands wipe the safety glasses with a damp cloth while an hourglass counts down beside them. No people.
shots.narration: 按厂家建议，保证足够的接触时间。

shots.scene: 小研在洗手池用肥皂和流水洗手
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student washes her hands with soap under running water at a lab sink.
shots.narration: 最后，用肥皂和流水洗手。

shots.scene: 手背、指缝、指甲下三处被圈出
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of two soapy hands with the backs, the spaces between fingers and under the nails circled. No people.
shots.narration: 手背、指缝和指甲下面都要搓到。

shots.scene: 泡沫双手旁一个计时器显示20
shots.prompt_en: Soapy hands rubbing together next to a timer icon. No people.
shots.narration: 至少搓洗20秒。

shots.scene: 速干手消毒剂瓶
shots.prompt_en: A pump bottle of alcohol hand rub with a blank label on a bench. No people.
shots.narration: 一时没有肥皂和水，可先用速干手消。

shots.scene: 手消瓶旁出现两个百分比图标
shots.prompt_en: The hand rub bottle with two percent sign icons beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 乙醇至少60%，或异丙醇70%。

shots.scene: 手消瓶指向洗手池的箭头
shots.prompt_en: An arrow from the hand rub bottle to a sink with running water. No people.
shots.narration: 之后，再尽快用肥皂和水洗手。

shots.scene: 绿色斜条背景，包头鞋打绿勾，凉鞋打红叉
shots.prompt_en: A green striped background; a closed-toe shoe with a solid upper marked with a green check, a sandal crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 补充一：穿包头、鞋面结实不透水的鞋。

shots.scene: 欣欣手拿空白风险评估表
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a clipboard with a blank risk assessment form.
shots.narration: 补充二：防护装备按风险评估来定。

shots.scene: 老周和小研对着空白表格讨论
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the female graduate student discuss a blank form at a desk.
shots.narration: 看本实验室和具体操作的风险。

shots.scene: 平面图：穿戴区和脱卸区之间有隔断
shots.prompt_en: A simple floor plan with a clean donning area and a separate doffing area divided by a wall. No people.
shots.narration: 补充三：穿戴区和脱卸区物理分开。

shots.scene: 干净衣物、个人物品和脏防护用品分处两边
shots.prompt_en: Clean coats and personal bags on one side, used gloves and coats on the other side, separated by a wall. No people.
shots.narration: 免得干净的东西被脏防护用品沾染。

shots.scene: 王老师指着墙上空白的流程图
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator points at a blank procedure chart on a lab wall.
shots.narration: 补充四：各单位穿脱流程不同。

shots.scene: 空白规程手册旁打一个对勾
shots.prompt_en: A blank procedure binder with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 要遵守本单位的制度和规程。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现储物柜、发圈、放大镜图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a locker, a hair tie and a magnifying glass.
shots.narration: 摘物品、束头发、查装备。

shots.scene: 衣、镜、手套顺序图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a lab coat, safety glasses and gloves linked by arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 穿：实验服、眼镜、手套。

shots.scene: 手套、实验服、眼镜、洗手的顺序图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons linked by arrows: gloves, lab coat, safety glasses, hand washing at a sink. No people.
shots.narration: 脱：手套、实验服、眼镜，再洗手。

shots.scene: 欣欣洗完手，挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot dries its paws with a paper towel by the sink and waves goodbye at the camera.
shots.narration: 穿脱有序，平安实验，下次见！
